Afghan Women Defy Taliban Restrictions in Hidden Gyms

Afghan women are finding ways to train and build sisterhood in hidden gyms, defying Taliban restrictions. These efforts are taking place amid doubts about the Taliban's policies and have drawn support from the Organisation of Islamic Cooperation (OIC). The coverage includes photographic insights into these hidden lives and a video showcasing a "Super Afghan Gym."
